name: kTailscale
author: mitanshu7 (packaged by kylep33)
description: KUAL extension to run Tailscale VPN, so you can SSH into your Kindle from anywhere. After installing, open KUAL > Tailscale > Install / Update Binaries, put your Tailscale auth key in extensions/tailscale/bin/auth.key, then Start Tailscaled and Start Tailscale. Needs KUAL and kernel 2.6.32+ (not PW1, K3, K4).
